slime.name: Wasteland Slime
slime.description: A gelatinous blob that absorbs radiation. Weak but annoying.

scavenger.name: Scavenger Rat
scavenger.description: Mutated rodent with razor teeth. Fast and aggressive.

bandit.name: Road Bandit
bandit.description: A survivor who preys on travelers. Armed with a rusty rifle.

mech_drone.name: Patrol Drone
mech_drone.description: Pre-war security drone still guarding ruins. Fires laser beams.

desert_worm.name: Sand Worm
desert_worm.description: BOUNTY: Giant worm that swallows vehicles whole. Slow but devastating.

iron_titan.name: Iron Titan
iron_titan.description: BOUNTY: A walking fortress from the old war. Heavily armored, extremely dangerous.

mutant_bear.name: Mutant Bear
mutant_bear.description: A massive bear mutated by radiation. Frenzied and tough.

toxic_bloom.name: Toxic Bloom
toxic_bloom.description: A pulsating fungal growth that releases toxic spores.

raider_elite.name: Elite Raider
raider_elite.description: A battle-hardened raider with military-grade weapons.

sentry_bot.name: Sentry Bot
sentry_bot.description: Heavily armored autonomous combat unit. Relentless pursuer.

steel_golem.name: Steel Golem
steel_golem.description: An ancient stone guardian infused with metal. Slow but nearly impenetrable.

swamp_lurker.name: Swamp Lurker
swamp_lurker.description: Amphibious predator that lurks in toxic waters. Strikes from ambush.

lab_security.name: Lab Security Bot
lab_security.description: Automated security unit guarding the underground lab. Armed with stun batons.

prototype_mech.name: Prototype Mech
prototype_mech.description: BOUNTY: Experimental war machine still active in the lab. The ultimate challenge.
